comment: Lookup table of allowed roles a person can hold on a course (e.g. Student, Instructor, Owner).

columns.name: code
columns.comment: Stable, short, machine-facing code for the role.

columns.name: sort_order
columns.comment: Explicit presentation order for this role, independent of code or alphabetical order.

columns.name: is_active
columns.comment: Whether this role is available for new selections. Retiring a value doesn't invalidate rows that already reference it.
